description: This file defines the FilePut interface in the com.salesmanager.core.modules.cms.content package. It declares methods for adding single and multiple InputContentFile objects associated with a merchant store, and may throw ServiceException.

classes.name: FilePut
classes.description: Interface defining methods for adding files to the CMS content module.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a single InputContentFile to the store identified by merchantStoreCode.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple InputContentFile objects to the store identified by merchantStoreCode.
